title: Ridgeline Installation Services Permit Fees and Old-Material Removal by Program
content:
Two program terms of Ridgeline Installation Services concern charges outside the installed price itself: whether the municipal permit fee is passed to the customer at cost together with a permit handling fee, and whether removal and disposal of the old material is part of the contract price or a separate haul-away fee.

| Program | Municipal permit fee billed at cost | Program permit handling fee (USD) | Haul-away of old material included in the contract price | Haul-away fee when not included (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Carpet Installation | no | 0.00 | yes | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Hard Surface Flooring Installation | no | 0.00 | no | 149.00 |
| Ridgeline Window and Door Installation | yes | 45.00 | yes | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Installation | yes | 75.00 | yes | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Bath Remodel Installation | yes | 75.00 | yes | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Roofing and Siding Installation | yes | 95.00 | yes | 0.00 |

## Reading the table

- The permit handling fee is the program's figure for pulling and managing a permit, charged when a permit is required. It is 0.00 on the carpet and hard surface flooring programs, which also do not pass the municipal permit fee through.
- Ridgeline Hard Surface Flooring Installation is the only program on which haul-away is not part of the contract price; its haul-away fee is 149.00. On every other program the haul-away fee figure is 0.00 because removal is included.

## Program questions answered

**Which program has the highest permit handling fee?** Ridgeline Roofing and Siding Installation, at 95.00; the kitchen cabinet and countertop and bath remodel programs are at 75.00 and the window and door program at 45.00.
